items.title: Freeze Claude-only real-host unattended contract
items.context: Document and encode that v1.0.1 only enables policy-bound claude-code real subprocess; Gemini/Codex remain scaffolded/refused, no auto-merge, no productionDone.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice help / README 示例时，会看到 dispatch_auto 可在 allowRealHostSubprocess=true policy 下启动 claude-code real runner，但仍显示 manual review / productionDone=false 边界。

happy.desc: Docs and CLI text describe Claude-only real subprocess v1.0.1, explicit policy opt-in, and unchanged authority fields.

edge.desc: Gemini/Codex remain documented as scaffolded or refused, with no wording claiming full real-host fleet support.

adversarial.desc: No doc or command description implies local Claude output can auto-merge, auto-DONE, or verify production receipts.

items.title: Add explicit real-host subprocess policy gate
items.context: Dispatch policy must require an explicit opt-in beyond allowedHosts, bind host/scope/commands/env/runtime limits, and keep standalone host_runtime_probe conservative.
items.userSees: 用户创建 claude-code policy 时必须显式传 allowRealHostSubprocess=true；否则 dispatch_auto 会清楚拒绝真实 Claude 启动并解释缺少 opt-in。

happy.desc: A policy with allowedHosts=claude-code plus allowRealHostSubprocess=true is authorized only when all existing receipt/review/budget/network/command constraints are valid.

edge.desc: A claude-code policy without explicit allowRealHostSubprocess stays supervised or refused for real subprocess launch even if allowedHosts includes claude-code.

adversarial.desc: Policy creation/check rejects unsafe env allowlist, auto-merge, productionDone, unknown hosts, out-of-scope paths, and real host subprocess attempts without explicit opt-in.

items.title: Implement Claude Code real runner lifecycle
items.context: Under dispatch_auto with authorized claude-code policy, spawn claude in isolated worktree with bounded env, timeout, stdout/stderr transcript capture, runner metadata, and terminal status mapping.
items.userSees: 用户运行 dispatch_auto 后，dispatch_status/dispatch_watch 显示 runnerKind=claude-code-real、cwd 为 isolated worktree、transcriptPath 和 exitCode/timedOut，而不是 scaffolded/manual-only。

happy.desc: dispatch_auto with an authorized claude-code real-host policy launches a bounded claude subprocess in the isolated dispatch worktree and records runnerKind=claude-code-real with transcript and exit metadata.

edge.desc: A claude subprocess exiting non-zero or timing out records failed status, exitCode/timedOut metadata, transcript output, and no accepted-local receipt.

adversarial.desc: The real Claude runner receives only filtered environment variables and never records secret values in runner metadata or transcript-created summaries.

items.title: Wire watch cancel collect review merge boundaries
items.context: dispatch_watch should expose real runner summary, dispatch_cancel should be able to terminate or mark cancellation safely, collect/review/merge_plan must keep receiptVerified=false and manualOnly=true.

items.title: Cover deterministic tests plus live canary evidence
items.context: Add fake claude binary smoke coverage for success, timeout, failure, env filtering, scope review, and real-host refusal when policy is absent; run a tiny live Claude canary only after deterministic tests pass.
